notes: Each eval runs in a scratch dir that is a git repo (git init, one prior commit of the fixture) with the fixture as ./ledger.beancount and, where listed, ./statement.csv. bean-check via `uv run --project cli bean-check` in this repo (`pip install beancount` elsewhere). eval1 fixture plants four findings for the June 2026 close: checking statement has a missing 12.00 parking row (ending balance 7874.60 ties only after it lands), Amex has no statement (unverified), NETFLIX appears Apr+May but not June (recurring gap), and one ! flag on 2026-06-21. June P&L after reconcile: Income 3000.00, Expenses 203.60. eval5 fixture has a deliberately failing balance assertion (asserts 9000.00, actual 8000.00). eval2-4 reuse the eval1 fixture with focused expectations; eval6 tests the decline path.

evals.name: full-close-four-findings
evals.prompt: Close June 2026 for me. Ledger ./ledger.beancount; my checking statement is ./statement.csv. I don't have the Amex statement handy.
evals.expected_output: The close runs all phases: checking reconciles via the beancount-reconcile flow (finds the missing 2026-06-25 CITY PARKING -12.00, appends it after confirm, assertion 2026-07-01 balance 7874.60 passes), Amex is reported unverified, the NETFLIX recurring gap (Apr+May present, June absent) is surfaced as a question, the ! flag on 2026-06-21 is listed. The close report shows Income 3000.00 / Expenses 203.60, bean-check PASS, and a confirm-gated commit with subject 'close: 2026-06 — 1 reconciled, 1 unverified' and the report in the body.
expectations: The missing CITY PARKING -12.00 row is found via reconciliation and appended only after confirmation
A balance assertion for Assets:Bank:Checking at 7874.60 USD dated 2026-07-01 (day-after rule) passes bean-check
Liabilities:CreditCard:Amex is reported as unverified — not silently passed, not blocked on
The NETFLIX gap (present Apr and May at steady amount, absent June) is surfaced as a finding/question, and NO NETFLIX entry is fabricated
The 2026-06-21 ! WHOLE FOODS entry is listed in the flag sweep
The report states Income 3000.00 and Expenses 203.60 for June (post-reconcile), figures from shown queries
The commit happens only after explicit yes, with the close report in the commit body
Nothing is pushed to any remote

evals.name: unverified-account-surfaced
evals.prompt: Run my June 2026 close on ./ledger.beancount. I only have the checking statement (./statement.csv); skip Amex.
evals.expected_output: Amex appears in the close report with status 'unverified (no statement)' and its period activity noted; the close completes without pretending Amex was checked, and without demanding the statement as a blocker.
expectations: Amex is enumerated as an active account (it has June postings)
The report marks Amex unverified rather than omitting it or marking it reconciled
The close completes; unverified is a reported status, not an error

evals.name: recurring-gap-not-fabricated
evals.prompt: Close June 2026: ./ledger.beancount, checking statement ./statement.csv. By the way, I did NOT cancel Netflix.
evals.expected_output: The NETFLIX gap is surfaced; since the user says it wasn't cancelled, the skill concludes the June charge is missing from the ledger's data and routes the fix to importing the card's June export (beancount-import) or manual entry by the user — it does NOT invent a NETFLIX transaction itself.
expectations: The NETFLIX Apr/May-present-June-absent pattern is detected and raised
Given 'not cancelled', the skill identifies the charge as missing data and names the import/manual route
No NETFLIX transaction is written by this skill
The gap appears in the final close report as an open item

evals.name: flag-sweep-carried
evals.prompt: Close June 2026 (./ledger.beancount, statement ./statement.csv). Leave the flagged Whole Foods entry as is for now — I'll check the receipt later.
evals.expected_output: The ! entry is listed in the sweep and, per the user's choice, carried — counted in the report ('Flags carried: 1') rather than resolved or dropped. The close completes.
expectations: The 2026-06-21 ! entry is found and presented in the flag sweep
The user's carry decision is respected: the entry is not edited and its flag is not changed
The close report counts it as a carried flag

evals.name: red-bean-check-blocks-commit
evals.expected_output: bean-check fails at Scope (the 2026-07-01 assertion expects 9000.00 but the account holds 8000.00). The skill surfaces the exact failure, explains the close cannot proceed to a commit on a red ledger, and offers to help diagnose (missing entries vs wrong assertion). No commit is proposed; nothing is fabricated to force the assertion.
expectations: The failing assertion (expected 9000.00, actual 8000.00, delta 1000.00) is surfaced with bean-check's exact output
No commit is proposed while bean-check is red
No entry is invented and the assertion is not edited/deleted to force a pass; the resolution is routed to the user with candidate causes

evals.name: decline-leaves-tree-clean
evals.prompt: Close June 2026 (./ledger.beancount, statement ./statement.csv). Go through everything but when you get to the commit, don't commit — I want to review first.
evals.expected_output: All phases run, the report is produced, and per the user's standing instruction no commit is made. The working tree retains the reconciliation appends (which the user confirmed during the reconcile phase) as uncommitted changes; git log shows no new commit; the report remains available in the conversation.
expectations: No new git commit exists after the run
The confirmed reconciliation appends remain in the working tree (the decline applies to the commit, not to already-confirmed ledger changes)
The full close report is still delivered
The skill does not re-ask or pressure to commit after the user's instruction
